market_pulse.theme: Regulatory changes and licensing in emerging markets
market_pulse.narrative: A wave of new gambling licences, tighter enforcement and novel penalties is reshaping markets in Africa, Asia and Europe, with regulators targeting online operators, late payouts and illegal activities.

market_pulse.theme: Growth and scrutiny of prediction markets and entertainment‑driven betting
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are moving from niche to mainstream, driven by events like Love Island and new platforms from Meta and Crypto.com, while regulators and industry bodies debate their legal status.

market_pulse.theme: Executive appointments and leadership moves across the iGaming ecosystem
market_pulse.narrative: Key operators and service providers are bolstering their senior teams – from CEOs of gambling authorities to VPs at consolidators – signalling a focus on strategic growth and governance.

market_pulse.theme: B2B marketing evolution and affiliate SEO challenges
market_pulse.narrative: Brands are adapting to new media‑buying models, technology stacks and the rise of black‑market affiliates, prompting a shift toward trust‑based strategies and more measurable ROI.

Operators are teaming up with technology providers (e.g., Super + ThrillTech, Sporting Risk + Entain NCE) and expanding product portfolios such as jackpots, lotteries and slot stakes to capture new revenue streams.

portfolio_wins.topic: Leadership and talent acquisition within iGB Affiliate
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our portfolio showcases proactive hiring of senior business‑development and content leadership, positioning us ahead of competitors who lack visible internal talent initiatives.

portfolio_wins.topic: Strategic M&A and high‑value investment analysis in the gaming sector
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our portfolio provides deep coverage of landmark deals and valuation narratives, exemplified by analysis of Icahn’s last‑minute Caesar bid and Banijay’s €32bn bet on a non‑existent market, positioning us as a go‑to source for deal‑flow intelligence.

Our portfolio provides in‑depth coverage of law‑enforcement actions against illicit betting, exemplified by the Taiwan police investigation, positioning us as a leading source on anti‑illicit gambling developments.

portfolio_wins.topic: Senior user acquisition talent in paid‑social channels
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: We highlight specialised senior acquisition roles focused on Snapchat and Meta, showcasing our insight into cutting‑edge user‑acquisition strategies that competitors are not covering.
Our coverage of middle‑level legal counsel roles demonstrates a deep understanding of the talent and compliance landscape, a niche not addressed by competitor articles.
